topic: 定语从句全攻略 (Attributive Clauses from Primary to Secondary)
teaching_notes:
1.【核心概念】：定语从句就像给名词戴上的“小帽子”或贴上的“说明标签”。它紧跟在被修饰的名词（先行词）后面，专门用来补充说明这个名词是“哪一个”或“什么样”的人或物。
2.【语法公式与口诀】：
   - 公式：先行词 + 关系词（who / which / that / whose / where / when / why）+ 从句。
   - 口诀：人用 who/that 物用 which/that；关系代词做主宾，缺人缺物仔细分；先行词若表所属，“谁的”要用 whose 跟着！关系副词看从句，不缺主宾选 where/when。
3.【中小学生易错点】：
   - 错误1：代词重复。如：The book which I bought it yesterday.（错在加了 it，which 已经代指 book 了）。
   - 错误2：介词后误用 that。介词直接放在关系代词前时，修饰人只能用 whom，修饰物只能用 which，绝不能用 that！
   - 错误3：主谓不一致。如：He is one of the boys who is...（应为 are，因为 who 代指复数 boys）。
4.【经典例句】：
   - The girl who is reading a book is my sister.（正在看书的那个女孩是我妹妹。）
   - This is the exciting game that we played last night.（这是我们昨晚玩的那个刺激的游戏。）
   - The classroom where we study is big and bright.（我们学习的教室又大又明亮。）

questions.question: The boy _____ is running on the playground is my classmate.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The boy（人），从句缺少主语，用关系代词 who。

questions.question: I lost the toy _____ my father bought for me yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the toy（物），从句中做宾语，用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: Look at the dog _____ tail is very short.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the dog，与 tail 是所属关系（小狗的尾巴），故用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: Do you know the teacher _____ speaks French so well?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the teacher（人），从句缺少主语，填 who。

questions.question: This is the storybook _____ has many beautiful pictures.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the storybook（物），做主语用 that 或 which。

questions.question: The man _____ lives next door is a famous doctor.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The man（人），指人用 who。

questions.question: The apple pie _____ Mum baked tastes sweet and delicious.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The apple pie（物），做 baked 的宾语，用 which。

questions.question: I have a friend _____ mother is a music teacher.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 friend，表达“朋友的妈妈”，用所属格关系代词 whose。

questions.question: The cat _____ has white paws belongs to Lucy.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The cat（动物/物），在从句中做主语，用 that。

questions.question: That is the house _____ has a big red door.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the house（物），从句缺少主语，用 which。

questions.question: The police caught the thief _____ stole the yellow bicycle.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the thief（小偷，指人），从句缺少主语，用 who。

questions.question: Is there anything _____ I can help you with?
questions.explanation: 当先行词是不不定代词（如 anything, something, everything）时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: The girl _____ bike was broken had to walk home.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The girl，表达“女孩的自行车”，用 whose。

questions.question: Here is the gift _____ I received on my birthday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the gift（物），做 received 的宾语，用 which。

questions.question: I like the park _____ is near our school.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the park，在从句中做主语（指的是这个公园本身，而不是在公园里发生某事），用 that 或 which。

questions.question: This is the science museum in _____ we spent the whole afternoon.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 直接放在关系代词前，先行词是物，只能用 which（in which = where）。

questions.question: The teacher to _____ you spoke just now is our new principal.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后面跟着指人的关系代词，必须用宾格形式 whom。

questions.question: I will never forget the day _____ I first visited the Great Wall.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the day（时间名词），从句结构完整（主谓宾齐全），故用关系副词 when。

questions.question: This is the small village _____ my grandfather lived thirty years ago.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 village（地点），live 是不及物动词，从句不缺主宾语，用关系副词 where（等于 in which）。

questions.question: He is the only student _____ passed the difficult physics examination.
questions.explanation: 当先行词被 the only, the very, the first 等词修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: Mr. Green, _____ is a well-known scientist, will give us a talk tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号隔开），先行词指人，不能用 that，只能用 who。

questions.question: Guangzhou is a modern city, _____ attracts millions of visitors every year.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句，从句缺少主语修饰物，不能用 that，必须用 which。

questions.question: Could you tell me the reason _____ you were late for the English class?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the reason（原因），从句主谓宾齐全，用关系副词 why（等于 for which）。

questions.question: Environmental pollution is a global issue to _____ we must pay close attention.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 pay attention to，介词 to 前置到关系代词前，指物只能用 which。

questions.question: All _____ glitters is not gold.
questions.explanation: 著名谚语“发光的并不都是金子”。先行词为不定代词 All 时，关系代词限定使用 that。

questions.question: She passed the national competition with top scores, _____ made her parents very proud.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句中，which 可以指代前面一整句话所表达的内容。

questions.question: This is the very novel _____ I have been looking for in the library.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the very（正是那个）修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: The company for _____ my elder brother works has developed a novel AI tool.
questions.explanation: 短语 work for the company，介词 for 提前，修饰公司（物），用 for which。

questions.question: _____ is known to all, the Earth revolves around the Sun.
questions.explanation: As 引导非限制性定语从句，置于句首，意为“正如……”，常用搭配 As is known to all（众所周知）。

questions.question: Great changes have taken place in my hometown, _____ makes all of us extremely excited.
questions.explanation: 逗号隔开的非限制性定语从句，用 which 代指前面“家乡发生巨大变化”这整件事，作从句主语。
